name: Baseline_limited
description: Baseline scenario with limits at 0.3% of world production.

name: Baseline
description: Baseline scenario with no material limits.

name: Baseline_limited_forced
description: Baseline scenario with limits at 0.3% of world production and where recycled material is forced to be directly used: the optimizer cannot intentionally stock material to use later in the horizon.

name: Baseline_cost
description: Baseline scenario without material limits, and where recycling is governed by the recycling cost vs the primary cost of a material. Results to be taken with care as recycling cost data is not entirely reliable.

name: Baseline_limited_01
description: Baseline scenario limited at 0.1% of world production.

name: Baseline_limited_induction
description: Baseline scenario limited at 0.3% of world production and where permanent magnet motors are gradually replaced by induction motors, until 100% of the motors are induction motors in 2050.

name: Baseline_limited_RR
description: Baseline scenario limited at 0.3% of world production and where mobility recycling rates follow a more neutral rather than optimistic trajectory.

name: Baseline_limited_watari
description: Baseline scenario limited at 0.3% of world production and where mobility material intensities are taken from Watari et al. 2019.

name: CCS_limited
description: Scenario where carbon capture is not limited and materials are limited at 0.3% of world production.

name: Public_Mob_increased_limited
description: Scenario where public mobility is increased and materials are limited at 0.3% of world production.

name: Baseline_limited_Dy
description: Baseline scenario limited at 0.3% of world production, where the Dysprosium availability constraint is relaxed.

name: Baseline_limited_DyLi
description: Baseline scenario limited at 0.3% of world production, where the Dysprosium and Lithium availability constraints are relaxed.

name: Baseline_limited_DyLiNd
description: Baseline scenario limited at 0.3% of world production, where the Dysprosium, Lithium and Neodymium availability constraints are relaxed.

name: Baseline_limited_DyLiNdPr
description: Baseline scenario limited at 0.3% of world production, where the Dysprosium, Lithium, Neodymium and Praseodymium availability constraints are relaxed.

name: Baseline_limited_DyLiNdPrAg
description: Baseline scenario limited at 0.3% of world production, where the Dysprosium, Lithium, Neodymium, Praseodymium and Silver availability constraints are relaxed.

name: Baseline_market_share
description: Baseline scenario without material limits in which market shares are imposed on wind and solar sub-technologies.
